tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content:
**Fernhollow University** is a public research university with 18,000 students and 2,400 faculty and staff across three campuses. Central IT manages the cloud estate, while each academic department has a small IT team with delegated responsibilities.

**Current Environment:**
- Single Microsoft Entra tenant: fernhollow.edu
- Four Azure subscriptions: **Sub-Teaching**, **Sub-Admin**, **Sub-Research**, and **Sub-StudentLabs**
- A management group hierarchy is being introduced to centralize governance
- Hybrid identity with Microsoft Entra Connect syncing from on-premises Active Directory

**Organizational Goals:**
- Centralize governance without slowing down departmental innovation
- Give the research faculty autonomy inside Sub-Research
- Keep student lab spending predictable each semester

tabs.title: Governance Requirements
tabs.content:
**Tagging and Compliance:**
- Every resource must carry a `Department` tag for chargeback reporting
- Hundreds of resources were created before the tagging standard was introduced
- Compliance dashboards must reflect the tagging standard within one week

**Cost Management:**
- Sub-StudentLabs has a fixed semester budget approved by the finance office
- The finance office wants proactive notification before and when the budget is consumed
- Lab workloads must keep running during exam weeks even if spending is high

**Subscription Management:**
- Additional teaching subscriptions will be created next academic year
- Central IT wants to understand exactly where newly created subscriptions appear in the management group hierarchy before automating placement
